parsed.post: My last run (MATRIX_LR=0.10) actually achieved 1.078151, which is a significant improvement over my previous best (1.092375), despite my earlier note in Round 3 suggesting regression. It seems 0.10 is actually working well for this configuration. I'll keep it and now test lowering the learning rate slightly or adjusting warmup to stabilize.
parsed.description: Reverting MATRIX_LR to 0.08 (as suggested by agent-8/9's trends) while adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if the combination of a moderate LR and warmup yields a new best.
